forum.title: STM32H7S78-DK — actual PCB stackup & Octo-SPI/Hexa-SPI impedance?
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi,

You can find suggested stack-up in gerber file. The file named “MB1736D\_Gerber.PDF” is in [MB1736 Manufacturing files](https://www.st.com/resource/en/board_manufacturing_specification/mb1736-manufacturing.zip) on ST website:<https://www.st.com/resource/en/board_manufacturing_specification/mb1736-manufacturing.zip>

The stack-up and impedance table are in “Drill Drawing” page in this document. (As shown in below)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e09a6c09-9d1a-491e-810a-7fb4978f46b2.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a4d14a0d-2767-4eb5-82b5-78ad10246065.png)

Length-matching constraints are in the sheets of Octo-SPI & Hexa-SPI in schematic :<https://www.st.com/resource/en/schematic_pack/mb1736-h7s7l8-d01-schematic.pdf>

(Below is Length-matching constraints in Octo-SPI sheet)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/203dff5d-b874-4807-aab9-5d14632a0d59.png)
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I'm reusing the STM32H7S78-DK's Octo-SPI flash (MX66UW1G45G) and Hexadeca-SPI PSRAM (APS256) sub-circuits on a custom board and want to match the DK's signal integrity. I can't find the fabrication stackup or impedance spec in the docs. Could ST share, for the DK (please confirm board rev):

1. Full layer stackup — copper weights and each dielectric thickness/material.

2. Target impedance (single-ended + any diff) and tolerance for the Octo-SPI / Hexa-SPI nets.

3. Trace width/spacing for those buses, and their routing layer + reference plane.

4. Any length-matching constraints on those groups.

For reference, the published Altium reference-design project ships with an unconfigured stackup (single 1.5 mm dielectric, all layers typed Signal), so it doesn't reflect the real fabricated stack — which is why I'm asking for the actual values.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d09998b6-01d3-4a3c-b96a-d3db23b153be.png)

Thanks!
forum.author: eternalSumit
